native_transport_observations.codex_existing_daemon_proxy: Confirmed bug: the native proxy tunnels WebSocket bytes, while the original connector sent JSON lines. A WebSocket upgrade over the same subprocess pipes successfully initialized and read account metadata from the existing Linux daemon.
native_transport_observations.compiled_linux_connector: Passed actual CodexProxy account/read with refreshToken=false and matching returned profile home. No thread requests, daemon restart or configuration overrides.

native_transport_observations.packaging: Use the npm ws implementation through an alias because the Bun built-in shim does not honor the custom pipe connection. Keep that dependency external and declared in the Node MCP package.

linux_access.resolution: The system SSH client accessed the existing private-key passphrase through macOS keychain integration. The earlier Homebrew SSH failure was a local credential-access limitation, not a rejected remote key.
